card.name: "the" before drug-resistant bacteria development
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after "increases the risk of" in the standard antibacterial warning that prescribing without a proven or suspected bacterial infection is unlikely to benefit the patient. It predicts "development of drug-resistant bacteria".

modes.label: Resistance warning sentence
modes.description: "the" after "increases the risk of" in the antibiotic-prescribing caution about drug-resistant bacteria.
modes.example: in the absence of a proven or strongly suspected bacterial infection or a prophylactic indication is unlikely to provide benefit to the patient and increases the risk of<< the>> development of drug-resistant bacteria. 5

card.plain: It marks the spot in the standard antibiotic warning where "the development of drug-resistant bacteria" comes next.
